scientific_integrity: The claims are supported by a complete finite-dimensional quadratic-form proof and 315 exact-rational supplemental checks. The earlier general finite-metric determinants and fixed-exponent multipartite results are credited, and no universal novelty or independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The formula treats finite simple unweighted complete multipartite graph metrics only. No above-threshold Hilbert-distortion values are claimed. The fixed p=1 complete multipartite quadratic-embedding classification is already known from Obata (2022). Independent priority and validation remain outstanding.
title: Collective negative-type thresholds for complete multipartite metric graphs
